branches_taken.adds: Three .gitignore lines that ignore .arena/, the per-session runtime folder written by main's `rd.py arena` (arena-gate).

(1) Motion Reel engine fixes: type.js sets dir=auto and normal letter-spacing on RTL lines (Arabic word reveals); beats.py sets NUMBA_CPU_NAME=generic on Windows (avoids CPU-specific native crashes in librosa/numba). (2) Six Golden Dragon Motion Reel presets: cinematic, clay, documentary, kinetic-type, product, whiteboard. (3) apps/golden-dragon/golden_codex.py: runs `dragon_fusion.py brief` and pipes it into `codex exec --sandbox read-only`, or scaffolds a new Motion Reel project from a preset via init.sh --preset.
`dragon_fusion.py find ... --json` prints the raw JSON result list; adds validation for --kind (missing value) and --limit (missing or < 1).

apps/golden-dragon/claude-app/: turns plain Claude Code into the Golden Dragon without the desktop app. install.py writes ~/.claude/golden-dragon/GOLDEN.md plus an import line in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, a UserPromptSubmit hook, agents, backups, and registers user-scope MCP servers golden-dragon-app + golden-dragon (--status/--uninstall). gen_prompt.py pulls SYSTEM/CC_NOTE/CONTROL_NOTE/RV_SYSTEM from app.py via ast. brief_hook.py runs `rd.py brief` before each message. golden_mcp.py is the MCP server (computer, system, browser, fusion, gold, skills, voice, compare, control) with Windows yes/no dialogs for dangerous actions and a corner emergency stop. Also INVENTORY.md, README, tests.

forge/unified_core/ (experimental 'native unified core'). runtime.py: GoldenDragonCore.execute with catalog.audit, source.audit, binary.pe_header (stdlib PE parser), binary.imports (REA CLI), media.probe (ffprobe with a local-only protocol whitelist), media.transcode (ffmpeg into a NEW TEMP file), blender.render (original gear/piston scene via headless Blender in TEMP), and a combined audit. native_registry.py: an allowlisted adapter table with native_status/native_exec; writes need approve_new_file. capability_ledger.py: catalog 'ok' vs real evidence, recipe-reference check. audit_tree.py/map_dependencies.py: source inventory. EXE tooling: build_standalone.py (compose the app without the bird forges, lazy Anthropic import, SHA-256 stamp), build_isolated.ps1 (TEMP-only PyInstaller), verify_unified_bundle.py, smoke_isolated_exe.py. Also 15 test files, a CI workflow, 3 dated verification reports, make_golden_dragon.py wiring (fusion actions audit/probe_media/inspect_binary_imports/transcode_media/native_status/native_exec), and maven_bridge.py (from the maven-bridge branch).

The newer state of the portable 'golden-dragon-fusion' skill that main holds in an earlier 7-file form. Rewritten SKILL.md (one request in, verified deliverable out). golden_dragon.pyz single-file runtime: request dispatcher for vertical 1080x1920 video, Windows PE inspection, inventory CSV to a verified vertical summary reel, SRT to WebVTT, and `--method TASK` quality brief from embedded policy.json/experience. scripts/: captions, srt_words, experience, production_method, inventory_reel, compile_policy, compose, methods, codebook (offline HTML book of capability-to-file links and duplicate bodies), source_map, coverage_snapshot, home_coverage, build_runtime. references/: recipes.json (42 portable recipes with acceptance checks), source-methods, source-snapshot, linked-media, home-coverage counts.

video-grabber: refresh yt-dlp automatically when older than 30 days and once after a failed download (retry only if the version changed); opt-outs --no-auto-update / VG_NO_AUTOUPDATE / KOSIF_NO_AUTOINSTALL; 4 tests. Plus a competing 'v3.5.2' release bump of root docs, manifests, RD_CHANGELOG, RD_MAP and rd.py VERSION.
